format: int16 little-endian, decimetres above NZVD2016, rows north to south, columns west to east

buildings.format: int16 stream per outline: tier (0 taller than 5 m, 1 low building near the city centre), height dm, min height dm, ground dm, n, n × (x, z) half metres in the world frame
buildings.heights: OpenMapTiles render_height: OSM height or building:levels where mapped, otherwise a 5 m default; not measured
buildings.outlines: exterior outlines only; courtyards are filled

sources.source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium PNG, zoom 13, about 15 m), s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod; in New Zealand their source is the LINZ 8 m DEM
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0, Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
sources.note: Copyright in the underlying dataset is owned by Regional Software Holdings Ltd (RSHL), as LINZ asks to be stated for the 8 m DEM. Heights over the sea are not used (the water mask decides land and sea).

sources.what: land cover, water, roads, rail and building footprints (ground colours)
